reviews.text: Juliana is a true professional! You can see the love and dedication she puts into her work. It's such a pleasure to find someone who treats our furry friends with so much love and care. Excellent service and fantastic results! Definitely highly recommended. 🐾❤️ …

We are delighted with UpDog Cuzco.
They treat the dogs wonderfully. Tricki comes running as soon as he smells the doggy daycare; he can't wait to go in.
Thank you so much. You are lovely.

We left our dog from Friday to Tuesday and couldn't be happier with the experience. The service was excellent, with so much love, attention, and dedication. We felt so reassured knowing he was in such good hands and that they were caring for him as if he were at home.

It's clear they love animals and truly care about their well-being. We will definitely be back and we wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy place to leave their furry friend. Thank you so much for taking such good care of him!

Exceptional service. The staff is wonderful. My dog ​​pulls me inside when we get to the area; that says a lot about the great service and how much he enjoys coming here.

We'll be back.

My experience was very negative, and the consequences for my dog, Arya, were extremely serious. She stayed at this hotel for a week, under their care and responsibility. When I picked her up, I noticed she was coughing during the drive, and when we got home, she was trembling. We took her to the emergency vet, where they told us she had kennel cough and advanced pancreatitis.

They also found a strange, sandy-looking material in her stomach, which the veterinarians indicated was a possible cause of the pancreatitis. I am extremely worried that, after a week under their care, they picked her up in that condition and with such an advanced health problem. I believe the monitoring was insufficient and that they didn't detect in time that something serious was happening to her.
Arya spent weeks in the ICU, very ill and in critical condition. She suffered complications, including pneumonia, and needed intensive care and plasma transfusions. Her life was in danger, and during those weeks, we didn't know if she would make it. Those were days and nights of fear, uncertainty, and immense anguish. I left Arya trusting that she would be cared for and monitored, and when we picked her up, we had to rush her to the emergency vet. It wasn't a passing ailment: it was a very serious situation that endangered her life. I have completely lost faith in this establishment. I do not recommend it and would never leave her there again. (In case they deny any suspicion, everything is plausible with veterinary reports.)

The grooming salon – A completely disappointing and unprofessional experience. I explained in detail to the groomer how I wanted my dog ​​Katyusha's hair cut (wanting to keep the length so I could style her two usual palm tree-shaped bows), and they cut her hair terribly and far too short, making it impossible to style her properly. Furthermore, without any aesthetic sense, they slapped on several glittery bits that look like they belong at a carnival. They don't listen to the customer, and the service leaves much to be desired. I hope the establishment will contact me to find a solution.

An exceptional place to leave your dog for a few hours or days while traveling. The service is outstanding, and you can tell they're dedicated to their business and committed to the well-being of the dogs. Highly recommended.

We're thrilled to have found UpDog for our two dogs. One is older and not a big fan of other dogs, and the other is a puppy who isn't very comfortable around people. Even so, they both stay here very happily and come right in, which says it all for us.

We also highly recommend the dental cleaning. It's done without anesthesia and takes just over an hour. The fact that our dog let them do everything without any fuss speaks volumes about the trust they have in the staff and how well they treat them.

I loved the experience from the very first moment. The service, the space, and the care they gave Bubble were all top-notch.

He had a trial run first, and when I went back to pick him up, he was happy. When he returned to stay for a couple of nights, he went right in, without hesitation, and that says it all for me.

Plus, the videos and photos they sent me throughout the day gave me so much peace of mind, seeing how happy he was.

I'll definitely be back. Thank you for taking such good care of Bubble! ❤️
Excellent service, very friendly and qualified staff, and they treat pets with great care. The oral cleaning service is highly recommended—it's quick, requires no anesthesia, and is risk-free.

My experience with Updog Cuzco has been excellent. They treat Sobao very well and make it very easy to leave the dog at the daycare or hotel. Sobao went for the first time when he was 3 months old and thoroughly enjoys his stay there with the other dogs and the caregivers.

This dog hotel is fantastic, I highly recommend it to all pet owners.
It gave me a lot of confidence and my dog ​​had a wonderful time.

Our greyhound Homie stayed with them for three weeks, and it was the best decision we could have made. Unlike other hotels, they sent us photos and videos every day, there was constant communication, Homie seemed happy... and most importantly for us: he didn't come back with an upset stomach or an injured leg (which has happened to us at other hotels). As soon as we go on another trip, Homie will go back to them, and I know he'll be safe and well cared for <3

This is the second time we've left Ginger at the hotel, and everything was great. They keep you updated on how your furry friend is doing all day long, and the care they give her is incredible. In fact, when we pick Ginger up later, she's a little down 😉
Thank you so much, guys, for taking such good care of her.

We left Chichi there for 9 nights and we were truly at ease because they sent us photos and videos every day.

The attention given to both dogs and owners is warm and caring, and that's the key to knowing we'll be back.

Thank you so much, team! 💘

I love this daycare because they treat the dogs wonderfully; you can tell they really like them, it's like a family. My dog ​​loves going; as soon as I stop the car, he runs to go in, and I feel so relieved because of how good it makes him feel to go.
A comfortable place for dogs and they are very well looked after.

Highly recommended. Very professional and trustworthy people. We always feel very relaxed when we leave our dogs with them, because we know they're in good hands! They communicate with us daily, which is greatly appreciated! We'll definitely be using them again! Best regards and keep up the good work. Greetings from Pippa and Poppy ;)

I left Pucho there with complete peace of mind because the Updog team is fantastic. They keep you updated with photos and videos, and you can see that the dogs are incredibly well cared for and happy. They also interact with other dogs and always sleep with a caregiver. It's definitely my go-to dog daycare and hotel ❤️

We were looking for a daycare and hotel for our one-year-old Beagle and had a wonderful experience. From the first contact for the free trial, we felt a great connection. They kept us informed via WhatsApp at all times, with photos and videos, and we were able to spend the weekend with peace of mind knowing he was with them. The staff is very kind and caring. We will definitely use them again when we need to!
We left our pet there for two weekends and our experience was very good. They are very calm because they send several videos every day. The second time we took her, she came in very happy.

A huge thank you to the whole team for taking such good care of Neska. She came home happy and refreshed. It's wonderful to find a place where the love for dogs is so evident and where you feel so calm from the very first minute. Neska has found her favorite daycare, and so do we!
Thank you also for the grooming service; she looks gorgeous!

My family and I are so happy we made the right decision leaving Rocco at this dog hotel. We were going to be away from him for almost a month, and he's never alone at home and eats homemade food. His care has truly been excellent. We've been kept informed about his stay at all times, and he was always out for walks, playing, and enjoying cuddles with the hotel staff. I want to extend my heartfelt thanks, through my family, to Marina, David, Cristina, Manuel, Helena, Patrick, Sergio, Alex, Arnold, and Jonathan—and if I've forgotten anyone, I apologize. They are the ones who make up this extraordinary team, ensuring that every dog ​​receives care and affection and doesn't feel so far from home. Congratulations!

Very professional, but above all, very kind and caring with the dogs. They make everything easy and always have a smile. I leave my dogs with complete peace of mind knowing they'll be cared for just like at home.
They are the best!!!!

We visited the center for a dental cleaning. The dogs looked fantastic, the service was excellent, and I loved the place! It's wonderful to find professionals who work with such quality and friendliness.

First, congratulations on your new venture with the opening of UpDog Cuzco. I was so happy to recognize the Gastamb team, especially the manager. I took my precious little one to the groomer. He made her look beautiful, and it was clear how well cared for she was. With several services available, including a vet consultation, it's highly recommended.

What impressed me most was the dental cleaning; the results were spectacular. That cleaning far exceeded my expectations.

I have nothing but words of gratitude for all the staff. She's not my dog, but her owner had a fall and I had to quickly find a place for her dog, Pepa. She's doing great, thanks to everyone for your kindness and dedication.

Our little sausage dog Bagel loves going here! Every time we walk nearby, he tries to go inside ☺️ the staff are super friendly, we get lots of video updates throughout the day where Bagel is so happy and having fun, would definitely recommend 🤍🫶🏼

We left our dogs at the dog hotel for two days and it was fantastic! The pups were so happy and it was definitely a vacation for them too. It's a place where they look after the safety and well-being of the dogs. We're very happy and will definitely return if we need to.

My dog ​​stayed for 3 days and the experience was excellent. From the very first moment, they instilled a lot of confidence in me, and you can see the love and care they give to the dogs. They kept me informed throughout his stay, and when I picked him up, he was calm, happy, and very well looked after. I will definitely use them again when I need to. Highly recommended! 😊🐶💫
I highly recommend Updog's services. Excellent service and customer care!
Excellent service and they made Bruno look fantastic, thank you!

We couldn't be happier with the experience. Our dog is very wary, and when we're separated from him, he usually has a hard time because he's afraid of practically everything. However, from the very first moment, he was completely at ease, both with the wonderful people who work there—you can see the love they have for the dogs—and with the other dogs.

What also gave us so much peace of mind was that they sent us lots of videos and photos every day so we could see how he was doing and how much fun he was having. That gives you enormous confidence when you leave your furry friend in someone else's care.

We are so happy with the experience and will definitely be back. Thank you so much for taking such good care of him!
My furry friend was there for seven days, and when I picked him up he was thrilled. He made other doggie friends, went for walks in the park… a perfect vacation for him!

I was delighted with the grooming service; my poodle came out looking gorgeous, and they took their time to ensure he didn't look brand new. I'm very happy with Tatiana's work (I think that's her name).

I've had to leave my two-and-a-half-year-old golden retriever at both the kennel and the hotel on several occasions. The staff are incredibly attentive and flexible. Whenever I need him to stay, I'll definitely leave him here.
We went for a haircut for my dog ​​and we were delighted. Excellent service, and our furry friend looked gorgeous.

We are delighted with them. Without a doubt, they are one of the best places we could have found in the area; a real find. I recommend them to everyone. They keep you informed at all times, sending videos and photos, they walk the animals, and they take care of them with so much love and attention... A top-notch service. We couldn't be happier! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ My little guy is happy. We've been with them for a month now, and everything has been wonderful.

I was looking for a hotel to leave my dog ​​in Madrid, and honestly, the experience has been fantastic. Both the information they send you about the hotel and the service are excellent.
It's a pleasure to see him arrive at UpDog and stay so happy.
Thank you so much for such a great job!

I've had to use this dog daycare several times, both for multi-day trips and for daycare, and I'm delighted. The staff is very friendly and professional, constantly providing updates on the dog's well-being and accommodating anything you need. Needless to say, my dog ​​is thrilled when I drop him off, and as soon as he walks through the door, he's eager to go upstairs to the daycare room.
Another great advantage for me is its proximity to my home in the city, which saves me from having to travel miles to drop off my dog. Based on my experience, I highly recommend this daycare.

For those who leave their dogs at kennels, every morning when I take my dog ​​out I see the kennel dogs being walked for a maximum of 5 minutes. I believe a dog should have quality walks, or at least longer ones. I should add that the walks I'm referring to are around 7:30 in the morning, when it's not hot at all and they can walk for more than 4 minutes.
I took my dog ​​Toribio to get a bath and he was so happy when I picked him up! The staff were very welcoming and I loved the customer service!
Professionals! I'm delighted with the grooming work done on my dog ​​Tobias 🐕. You're very kind, I would definitely use you again and again. Wishing you much success! 👍🤗👏👏👏 …

UpDog Hotel and Dog Daycare is 100% recommended. Reliable professionals who keep you updated in real time on your dog's activities, take them out, take care of them, and make sure they have fun. My dog ​​is happy and I'm at ease. He's learned the route to daycare and greets the staff if he sees them on the street. They also have a grooming salon and veterinary clinic. Finding them has been a real relief, and I recommend them to all my friends.

They're the best! They take such good care of Nash!! The facilities are perfect; my dog ​​has a lot of fur, and with this heat, he has a wonderful time there since they have air conditioning all the time. They give him lots of cuddles... and it gives us so much freedom since they're open on weekends too! 100% recommended!

We couldn't be happier with our dog Baggy's experience at the hotel. The love, attention, and professionalism with which they care for the dogs is evident 😀
The information provided during her stay, with photos, videos, and messages, is exceptional and gives us so much peace of mind.
And the best proof of how well they cared for her was picking her up happy and content. We will definitely be back and highly recommend it.

Thank you
Thank you for taking such good care of my dog. It was her first stay and she left very happy.
Thank you, Beatriz

We are so grateful for the care, attention, and follow-up during our dog's stay at the hotel.
It's very well cared for and spacious, and you know he'll always be surrounded by other dogs to play with and people looking out for his safety.
They also keep you updated with photos and videos of our little one. We'll definitely be back, and Eru will be thrilled.

This time I used their hotel service and everything went perfectly. I felt very reassured being able to stay in constant contact with them; they sent me photos and videos every day.
Excellent service, and they have everything very well organized to welcome our furry friends and ensure they have a great stay. We'll definitely be back!

I highly recommend this place! I finally found what I'd been searching for for five years. The service is personalized for our furry friends, and the grooming and bathing are absolutely fantastic. I have a Saint Bernard, and this is a great place for all breeds. Thank you so much to Taty, my Murditock's groomer!

Hello everyone. My daughter and I have had a furry friend for 14 years. He's a Toy Poodle named Indiana. In all these years, he's never left our side, except for a few days when he had to spend time in a clinic. Due to personal circumstances, we had to take him to stay at Up Dog Cuzco for a few days, and the experience couldn't have been more positive, both for him and for us. They treated Indiana, like the other doggy friends, with great professionalism and affection, and kept us informed at all times about how he was doing and what he was doing. We already knew Up Dog as a daycare, through Sofi, who works there and is wonderful, but now we've experienced it as a dog hotel, and we'll definitely go back if we need to again. Highly recommended!! Thank you to everyone who works there, especially David. I'm sorry I don't remember the names of his colleagues, but they are all wonderful.

Susana Maestu
They are incredibly kind and loving with our furry friends.
Thank you, Francisco José 😊 …

A super positive experience with the Updog team 🐶❤️
They always send tons of videos, and you can really see the dedication and love they put into each dog.

My dog ​​was super shy at first, but he left happy, so happy… he didn't want to leave! 😂

Highly recommended!
Many thanks to Marina for her dedication and commitment to my dog. I'm delighted to see her trusting me more and more each day. This is especially challenging considering she was a stray dog.
My dog ​​came back very well cared for. There was good communication, meaning videos and photos. You can tell my dog ​​came back very happy; I'm grateful and happy. I would definitely take him again.
The second day I took my dog ​​to daycare, he was practically dragging me along, so eager to go back! That says it all! Total trustworthiness and highly recommended.

This is the second time we've taken Lino for a few days, and we couldn't be happier. He has a fantastic time, we can travel worry-free, and they keep us updated the whole time. They send us videos of him playing. They tell us if he's eating or sleeping well… everything is perfect. It's definitely worth it.

We recently met Updog Cuzco and since then it became our favorite place! My Toy Poodle was a super shy and scared dog and with their care and love now she is socializing, playing with other dogs and having a lot of fun! They also keep you informed by sending you lots of videos and photos throughout the day! Thank you so much to the great team!

Excellent service, very empathetic and knowledgeable staff.
The facilities are top-notch and brand new.
My dog ​​is very happy, and they keep me informed about everything. UpDog has once again demonstrated its excellence in service.

The best dog daycare ever! Leaving my Australian Shepherd at UpDog Cuzco was the best decision I made. The staff are incredibly kind and you can tell they have a real passion for dogs. My dog ​​always comes home happy and tired from playing so much. It gives me so much peace of mind to leave him there while I work. Thanks to the whole team, 100% recommended!
Our Oliva spent the weekend at the hotel and it was a fantastic experience for her! She seemed so happy and pampered. We'll definitely be back! 🩷 …
Thanks, Borja!

An excellent alternative to conventional dog kennels.

A different concept from a typical kennel, offering personalized attention tailored to each dog's personality. A trial period is required before acceptance, ensuring that all dogs sharing the facility are sociable and well-behaved. Accommodation is in a controlled "pack" both day and night to guarantee harmony and well-being for all residents. Individual boarding is also available, or a combination of both options can be arranged.

They send photos and videos upon request, providing peace of mind that other kennels don't offer. Excellent treatment for both us and our "babies." 100% recommended.

We are so happy with this dog daycare. From day one, Muñeco has been incredibly well cared for. In fact, he loves going: he arrives and runs excitedly to go inside! 😂

You can really see the love and dedication that all the staff have for the dogs. Muñeco is happy with his friends, and we feel so much more at ease knowing he's in such good hands.

Also, something we love is that they create a WhatsApp group and constantly send photos and videos so you can see how your dog is doing and how much fun he's having. That gives us so much peace of mind and confidence.

The value for money is excellent, and they also have a discounted grooming service, which is fantastic and we loved it.

We would definitely go back a thousand times and highly recommend it. Thank you so much, guys, for taking such good care of Muñeco! 🐶💛
And the dog grooming salon is highly recommended
Thank you so much, Katrine 🤩 …
The place is very well maintained and super clean. The staff are lovely. I took my dog ​​to get her hair cut and she looked gorgeous. I'll definitely be back.
Fantastic place for dogs. Both the daycare and the grooming salon.
The dogs have been very happy and have been treated very well. They've received the affection they needed most.

We've left our dogs at this kennel several times and have always had a very positive experience.
We especially want to highlight the excellent work of Cristina, who from the very first moment inspires confidence, affection, and a deep respect for the animals. Thanks to her dedication and that of the rest of the team, the animals' stay is much more comfortable and enjoyable. We will definitely be back.
The best quality control is done by our dog Nora: every time we walk past the UpDog door, she wants to go back in. A good sign.
Excellent service and attention to detail, highly recommended

We're very happy with Yago's results. We went last week for a teeth cleaning (without sedation) and the results were quite good.

The team was very friendly and the service was fantastic. He was done in about 45 minutes.

I highly recommend this service.

I discovered UpDog three days ago through an online ad for dog dental cleanings WITHOUT anesthesia! It was quite a shock to me, as terriers are very prone to cavities, and no vet had ever mentioned this option to me. I made an appointment, and today they treated my dog... almost an hour with her, and I was able to wait in the shop area. I'm still amazed at how her mouth looks! Sparkling, clean, perfect. David at reception was fantastic. Very kind and professional. I paid €100, much cheaper than traditional cleanings, which require pre-operative procedures (all too invasive for the animal and disastrous for my wallet). Thank you so much for today's dental cleaning service!! And for sending me the before and after photos! See you soon!

My experience with Updog has been fantastic! I left my dog ​​at the hotel for 5 days. They sent me lots of videos and updates. They understand that every dog ​​is unique and take that into account at all times. I will definitely use the service again.

A fantastic experience!
Fiona stayed with them overnight at their boarding facility and came back absolutely delighted.
Their welcoming process for the animals was outstanding: they take their time to check that your dog has everything they need for their stay, separating them into a box with their name on it, noting down meals, medication, and any other details. It's one of those things that gives owners complete peace of mind.
They also sent me photos and videos throughout their stay, both before bedtime and early in the morning. I'm sure we'll be back as soon as we need to; we're so happy! 😊

I'm very happy with the grooming service at UpDog. They treated Zeus with so much care and made him look gorgeous. They even managed to trim his nails, something that had always been impossible at other places. Highly recommended!
A top-notch place that prioritizes animal welfare above all else! Our dog Blinky couldn't be happier!

We left our poodle for 5 nights and he was well cared for the entire time. We received many pictures and videos and returned to a happy, tired pup.  The prices are reasonable, the place is clean and the staff is friendly.

I want to express my sincere gratitude to Up Dog for the wonderful care they have provided my dog, Cindy. Since I adopted her a year and two months ago, she has faced many challenges, including fears and insecurity, to the point that she even had trouble eating properly.

After just two days at the doggy daycare, I've noticed a radical change in her behavior. Cindy has begun to show much more confidence and is enjoying her walks. Although she's still a little scared when going outside, her attitude and energy have improved remarkably. Seeing her like this fills me with joy.
One aspect I truly love about Up Dog is the personalized attention they provide. They constantly send me videos of them playing and walking, which makes me feel more connected to Cindy while she's there. Furthermore, I have peace of mind knowing that, during the intake process, she's surrounded by well-balanced and socialized dogs. This assures me that she'll be in a safe and happy environment, away from any risks.
I also want to highlight the attention they pay to the dogs' physical well-being. They consulted me about whether Cindy was going into heat, which shows they are attentive to her health and any aspect we might overlook. This kind of support is invaluable, as it makes them feel like part of a team that genuinely cares about our pups' needs.

In addition, Up Dog offers a full range of services that make life so much easier: they have food, veterinary care, and dog grooming options all on hand. This means I can rest assured that Cindy will be well cared for in every way while she's there.
The professionalism and kindness of the entire team are exceptional. Recently, Cindy got sick, and I couldn't take her to the doggy daycare. I was pleasantly surprised by their concern, checking in on how she was. That kind of attention truly reflects the love and commitment they have for our furry friends.
I'm also considering using their hotel service for Cindy, as I have complete confidence that she'll be well looked after. Thank you, Up Dog, for being such an amazing place! Their dedication and love make a huge difference in the lives of our dogs and in our own.

Keep up the great work!

I 100% recommend UpDog! David and the team treated Nox wonderfully, and he had a happy week playing with them and his new friends.

Not only did they treat Nox great, but they were also very patient with us, as we were nervous about leaving him there for so many days for the first time.
They sent us photos and videos every day, answered our questions, and Nox came back happy.
We also took advantage of the opportunity to have him groomed. That's a fantastic bonus, as is the veterinary care.
Thank you so much, UpDog team, we'll be back soon! 🐾

I cannot recommend Updog Hotel Canina enough! My dog, Benito, recently stayed there, and it truly felt like a home away from home for him.
The staff are incredibly sweet and thoughtful. One of my favorite parts of the experience was receiving regular videos and pictures throughout his stay. It gave me such peace of mind to see him happy, playing, and well-cared for while I was away.
If you are looking for a place that will treat your furry friend like family, this is it. Benito will definitely be back! 🐾

Perfect! The daycare, the service, the communication from the daycare (sending us photos and videos), the cleanliness… Absolute top marks!! 100% recommended.

Thank you for taking such good care of Max!

For Yuki, our Shih Tzu, and for us, the experience has been excellent: professional attention, trust, and peace of mind. David greeted us with a warm and friendly smile from the very beginning, which motivated us to stay and give it a try. Bea, the ethologist, brings both rigor and empathy; thanks to her explanations and advice, Yuki is calmer, and so are we.
Taty, the groomer, stands out for her patience and professionalism, ensuring that Yuki enjoyed her first visit peacefully and even let us touch her face, something we hadn't been able to achieve at home. The thoughtful gesture of sending us a video of her first bath demonstrates genuine care for pets and families. Thank you for your dedication.

If you're looking for authentic pampering and personalized attention for your pet, this center is the best option. Having all the services in one place provides convenience and peace of mind. Thank you for taking care of Yuki and making us feel part of the Updog family.
As always, a great choice! Excellent staff and top-notch facilities. 100% recommended

I couldn't make it to drop off my dog, but all the help they gave me and how friendly they were made it clear that this isn't your average dog daycare. As soon as I have the chance, I'll definitely be leaving him there.
Incredible service at the daycare, they are very attentive and understanding.
We are very happy with the care and patience they showed our dog at the grooming service. The facilities are fantastic and the staff are wonderful. We will definitely be back.
The professionalism and care they show your pet is truly exceptional. We'll be back.

Five-star hotel, it couldn't have been better described. My dog ​​was delighted; he slept on top of the caregiver. Wonderful.

I'll be back.
Exceptional service. Our dog loves it. A real find!

I have a 6-year-old Yorkie who had his bath and haircut at UpDog Cuzco. We were very satisfied; Milo looked great, and the cut was exactly what we asked for. The finish was impeccable, and so far, it's the best he's had in Madrid!
Rumba left super happy! And the hairdressing service left her looking perfect.
Excellent place, seeing the dogs so happy is amazing. The service was top-notch; they even sent us photos and messages about how the dogs were doing.

I took my dog ​​to the doggy daycare and the experience was excellent. The staff was wonderful from the very beginning; you can tell they truly care about the animals' well-being.

My dog ​​came out super happy, so I'll definitely be back!

I've taken my dog ​​there twice and we're delighted!
It's an excellent comprehensive center. They are very professional. Their ethics and expertise are outstanding. The service has been impeccable.

I left my pet there because I had to leave town for work, and I was very pleased with the experience. The staff was very friendly, and it's clear they treat the dogs with love. Everything was well-organized, and I always felt confident.

When I picked her up, she was happy and well cared for, so I would definitely leave her there again. I highly recommend it.

We took our border collie in for a bath and it was truly wonderful in every way, both the service and the results. It's a pleasure to leave your pet in such good hands. We'll definitely be back. Welcome to the neighborhood!

I loved the facilities; they look well-maintained, clean, and perfectly adapted for the well-being of the dogs.
Everything is designed so they can enjoy themselves, move around, and feel right at home.

Without a doubt, it's a place all dogs will be eager to return to. The care and dedication are evident in every detail.
Very friendly. Great facilities.
It was a fantastic experience! Very professional, fast, and very friendly! We'll definitely be back soon! Thank you!
Very good service
Super friendly, excellent service, they will undoubtedly be a success in the neighborhood.

Today I took my Maltese Bichon Popi to the groomer for the first time, and I was thrilled with how they did her and the wonderful service. I've been to many groomers and always left disappointed; I thought I was just too demanding, but seeing today's results, I realize that's not the case. I highly recommend them! 🤩 …

Today Lola and Gala enjoyed a day at daycare and also had a dental cleaning without sedation, using an ultrasonic toothbrush 🦷✨ (I'm sharing before and after photos because the difference is incredible).

And I have to say, I loved the center. They also showed us the boarding area, and it's absolutely fantastic 🏕️💛 The round bed where the caregiver sleeps with the dogs, like a campsite, was the best... no cages, just comfort, love, and companionship.

They also have a veterinary clinic and grooming salon, so they have everything in one place.

Thank you, guys, for taking such good care of my little ones 🫶🐾

I'm so happy with the result! I took my wirehaired dachshund, Roma, in, and they gave her the cut using the correct technique (stripping). She looks gorgeous!

Plus, they treated her wonderfully, and she left very happy! We'll definitely be back 😊
Allegra is so happy every day she goes to daycare. David and Cristina are very loving, and I feel completely at ease knowing she'll be well cared for.

I loved this place and the way the professionals treated me. I took my dog ​​for a dental cleaning. She'd never had one done before, and I was encouraged to go for it when I learned she didn't need sedation. They finished in less than an hour. Afterwards, I left her at the doggy daycare for a few hours as a trial, since I have a trip coming up that I can't take her on, and she'll be staying with them for those days.
